in_sanskrit.name: Sharjin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Son of the God of the Sun
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharjin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharjin is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of two words - 'Shar' meaning Sun and 'Jin' meaning Son. Thus, Sharjin can be interpreted as the Son of the Sun God.
